terms_body:
By using ShatabX you agree to use the account to manage finishing projects and site inspections, to keep project and report data private, and not to share verification codes.

The company must keep engineer and report data accurate. The platform may suspend an account that is misused or used for content unrelated to construction.

Quality reports and attached photos are used only to follow execution and approve stages, and are not shared outside the company account without the owner’s approval.
